title: 900 S Rosemary Hotel - Approvals to Watch
location: City of West Palm Beach / Palm Beach County
description: The Planning Board recommended approval of the 18-story, 400-room convention-center hotel on June 16, 2026. City Commission and Palm Beach County approvals are still required; hearing dates had not been set as of early August.

title: Downtown Master Plan - Resident Engagement Relaunch
description: The City paused committee reviews of the Downtown Master Plan update after public pushback and plans additional community meetings with a resident partnership process beginning this fall. Watch the Planning Division page for dates.
